subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu text commands (/stop, /new, /status) no longer bypass queue during active agent run (3.8 regression)

question: Which Feishu text slash commands should bypass the same-chat queue during an active run?
rationale: Current code proves the report is only partially fixed, but `/new` is stateful and can affect active session lifecycle, so automation should not choose the permanent command-lane policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Narrow safe bypass
options.body: Keep `/stop` on the abort control lane, add a read-only immediate lane for `/status`, and make `/new` behavior explicit before changing it.

options.title: Bypass all command-only text
options.body: Route all authorized whole-message Feishu slash commands to a separate command lane, accepting the need for stronger tests around stateful commands and ordering.

options.title: Split remaining behavior
options.body: Close the abort portion as fixed, track `/status` and `/new` under a broader Feishu slash-command issue, and update docs if stateful commands intentionally stay queued.

recommendation.title: Narrow safe bypass
recommendation.body: Keep `/stop` on the abort control lane, add a read-only immediate lane for `/status`, and make `/new` behavior explicit before changing it.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision sits at the command-turn fast-path and channel dispatch boundary that recent work by this owner touched.
